complete.message: What a cast of characters! You have explored every invitation in this set. The music is yours from here.

default.title: The first spark
default.message: Give our little orchestra a smile. Even a quiet one can open the show!
default.hint: Let the corners of your mouth lift comfortably and hold for a moment. There is no need for a huge grin.
default.encouragement: Every orchestra starts somewhere. Your expression is enough to get us going.
default.congratulation: There it is — your first spark! The orchestra has found its sunshine.
default.retryMessage: We can save the first spark for later. Your other discoveries still count; let us try another invitation.

default.title: The plot twist
default.message: The orchestra has found a tiny dragon in the piano. Give us your surprised face!
default.hint: Try opening your mouth into a comfortable O. Relax your smile; raised eyebrows are optional.
default.encouragement: A little theatre, a little wonder. There is room for your version of surprised.
default.congratulation: What a plot twist! Your surprise has a starring role.
default.retryMessage: We can save the plot twist for later. Your other discoveries still count; let us try another invitation.

default.title: Comet post
default.message: Send a kiss into the musical universe. Somewhere, a very small comet is waiting for its post.
default.hint: Gently bring your lips forward as though blowing a kiss. You do not need to make a sound.
default.encouragement: Take your time with this delivery. We have plenty of universe left.
default.congratulation: Special delivery! Your comet kiss has arrived in a shower of imaginary stardust.
default.retryMessage: We can save comet post for later. Your other discoveries still count; let us try another invitation.

default.title: The secret signal
default.message: The drummer has a secret. Can you answer with a wink?
default.hint: If comfortable, close either eye briefly while keeping the other open. You can let this invitation pass and try it when it returns.
default.encouragement: Either eye can send the signal. This is a secret handshake for faces.
default.congratulation: Signal received! You and the drummer are officially in on the secret.
default.retryMessage: We can save the secret signal for later. Your other discoveries still count; let us try another invitation.

default.title: A little mischief
default.message: A very serious conductor has entered the room. Stick out your tongue and add a little mischief!
default.hint: Try gently showing your tongue, with your eyes open or closed. No need to stretch or strain.
default.encouragement: Serious musical qualifications: none. A willingness to be a little silly: welcome.
default.congratulation: Excellent mischief! The conductor has misplaced their serious face.
default.retryMessage: We can save a little mischief for later. Your other discoveries still count; let us try another invitation.

default.title: The quiet island
default.message: Our orchestra has reached a quiet island. Let your face settle into a calm, neutral expression.
default.hint: Let your mouth and eyebrows rest comfortably, with your eyes open. Nothing needs to be forced.
default.encouragement: A quiet moment belongs in the music too. You do not have to perform at full volume.
default.congratulation: A lovely moment of calm. You have made room for the next musical adventure.
default.retryMessage: We can save the quiet island for later. Your other discoveries still count; let us try another invitation.

default.title: The curious detective
default.message: Who put a trumpet in the biscuit tin? Try raising one eyebrow, like a curious detective.
default.hint: Try lifting just one eyebrow while keeping your mouth relaxed. This is a tricky one; take your time, or try it again in a later round.
default.encouragement: Curiosity is a musical skill. A perfect detective face is entirely optional.
default.congratulation: Case opened! That eyebrow has questions, and the biscuit tin has explaining to do.
default.retryMessage: We can save the curious detective for later. Your other discoveries still count; let us try another invitation.

default.title: Front-row wonder
default.message: The curtain rises on something unexpected. Lift both eyebrows for a wide-eyed moment of wonder.
default.hint: Try raising both eyebrows with your eyes open and your mouth comfortably closed.
default.encouragement: You are in the front row of your own little show. Take a moment to look astonished.
default.congratulation: Curtain up! Your look of wonder deserves its own spotlight.
default.retryMessage: We can save front-row wonder for later. Your other discoveries still count; let us try another invitation.

default.title: The crooked cadence
default.message: One corner of the tune has wandered off. Try a lopsided smile to bring it home.
default.hint: Try lifting one corner of your mouth more than the other. Keep the movement comfortable; a small sideways smile is the idea.
default.encouragement: A little asymmetry gives this tune its character. There is no need to make both sides match.
default.congratulation: Delightfully lopsided! Your tune has found a character all of its own.
default.retryMessage: We can save the crooked cadence for later. Your other discoveries still count; let us try another invitation.
